admission.justification: Occurrence identity must survive maintenance of fingerprint production, reader propagation and acknowledgement observations. Using sampled rows, counts or timestamps can hide genuinely new findings or re-alert unchanged failures; current full-set and recovery/restart source assertions guard that specific failure.

applicability: Persisted acknowledgement and source-derived visibility for the four currently supported operational attention kinds, including full actionable drift occurrence fingerprints.
conditions: Identity is the fully qualified current itemId; fingerprint input is the complete canonical actionable finding list, including multiplicity, not its sample, count, order or checkedAt.
Healthy recovery includes complete source proof that a configured/current subject left its live set; a later failure is then a new occurrence.
Missing legacy fingerprints can adopt the first complete current identity without resurfacing merely for migration; a source restart or changed check timestamp is not recurrence.
exclusions: Removed lifecycle attention kinds or task-state/review acceptance.
A claim that an incomplete read must hide a valid positive changed occurrence; visibility and destructive acknowledgement cleanup are distinct.
statement: Only a changed actionable drift set or an observed healthy-to-failed recurrence resurfaces a dismissed operational item.
